remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully refreshed spacious two-story home in the desirable Town of Tonawanda! Offering a wonderful blend of charm, comfort, and thoughtful updates, this spacious home features a welcoming living room with hardwood floors and a decorative fireplace, along with a formal dining room accented by beautiful hardwood flooring. The galley kitchen offers a convenient pantry and opens to a casual eating area adjacent to the inviting family room, complete with a cozy gas fireplace, convenient half bath and sliding glass door leading to an inviting back deck.

A unique feature of this home is its two staircases! The main staircase leads from the living room to the second-floor bedrooms, while a second staircase from the family room provides direct access to the primary bedroom suite with its own private bath, featuring a newly installed shower.

Recent improvements include fresh paint throughout, new closet doors, updated lighting in select areas, a freshly painted deck, newer windows throughout, and a young roof. All appliances are included for added convenience! Outside, enjoy the fenced backyard and deck, perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing. With its versatile floor plan, generous living spaces, charming details, and numerous updates, this inviting home is ready for its next chapter!
